title: Nondeterministic oracle time class
statement: For an oracle language $O$ and a time bound $T\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, the nondeterministic oracle time class consists of all languages $L$ for which there are a natural number $c$ and a nondeterministic oracle Turing machine that decides $L$ relative to $O$ within time $cT(n)$ on inputs of length $n$.
